boundedHypothesis: A newly authored FiPy 4.0.3 cell-centred finite-volume adapter, executed from the exact project-private content-addressed runtime lock, can preserve and machine-distinguish the official PFHub 7(a) literal-boundary task, a literal-BVP self-comparison contract, and a non-PFHub exact-trace companion while matching a clean-room dense discretization oracle through a two-step solver smoke with finite controlled algebraic residuals. This preflight does not test spatial or temporal convergence and cannot validate a physical model, real material, causal effect or industrial process.

prefreezeReviewDispositions.disposition: The alpha interval is exact rational text, the analytic bound is exact symbolic text, and its optional decimal display is rounded outward up.
Every PFHub-native quantity is dimensionless because the benchmark declares no SI dimensional map; each basis still identifies its reduced-coordinate role.
A no-FiPy, no-R17 dense finite-volume oracle now independently assembles A and b and advances both steps for both boundary tracks.
The linked adc0b2e commit date is corrected to 2018-03-07 and remains reference-only.
Problem boundary provenance and metric provenance are now separate booleans for every track.

whyThisPrecedesConvergence: R17a and R17b do not provide a maintained-framework PDE lane independent of their custom numerical implementations.
The prior shared mutable Python runtime is an open R17b P2 and cannot support a stronger R18a execution claim.

Official-literal analytic discrepancy, literal-BVP self-convergence and exact-trace strict MMS answer different questions; their identities must be executable and fail-closed before an expensive convergence matrix is frozen.
All exploratory calibration values and matrices observed before this freeze are excluded from this candidate and from later formal evidence.

implementation.timeIntegrator: first-order semi-implicit Euler: diffusion at n+1; nonlinear reaction and manufactured source at n; exact-trace Dirichlet data at n+1
implementation.linearSolver: FiPy serial SciPy LinearPCGSolver with criterion='RHS', tolerance=1e-12, absolute_tolerance=1e-14, iterations=2000 and precon=None; exactly one solve per registered step
implementation.independence: The adapter must not import, invoke or derive numerical loops, endpoint values, source helpers or pass/fail results from any R17a or R17b implementation. It may share only the official problem statement and locked source identity.

preflightMatrix.timeRule: exact integer for-loop; require stepCount*dt==finalTime within 2 ulp; no while-loop endpoint, partial step, interpolation, retry or adaptation
preflightMatrix.literalSelfPreflight: Exercise only the conservative 2-by-2 restriction mapping on a synthetic affine cell-centred field. Do not call it a BVP convergence run.
preflightMatrix.diagnosticOnlyMetrics: The two tiny-grid endpoint discrepancies and their field difference are smoke diagnostics and are forbidden from any convergence fit, ranking or evidence-score increase.

runtime.hostResidualBoundary: Darwin kernel, dyld, /usr/lib, /System/Library, hardware, firmware and Accelerate numerical behavior are outside byte closure and remain a reported P2 limitation.

identityAndIsolation: Strict duplicate-key JSON parsing accepts the exact preregistration and runtime lock and rejects duplicate keys.
The source CPython closure, every wheel, expanded wheel closure and combined runtime closure exactly match the frozen counts, byte sizes and SHA-256 digests before execution.
The materialized runtime directory is named by the exact lock-byte SHA-256, contains only frozen regular files, and is sealed read-only.
The child sys.prefix, sys.base_prefix, sys.executable and every non-built-in module origin remain in the private runtime except the exact candidate worker.
Loaded Darwin native images are inventoried and every non-system image is under the private runtime.
FiPy reports 4.0.3, NumPy 2.5.3, SciPy 1.18.1, packaging 26.3 and solver suite scipy.
Only the exact registered fipy.tools.numerix numpy.core DeprecationWarning is ignored; an injected different warning must fail.
scientificSemantics: The mesh has 32 unique cell centres, Nx=8, Ny=4, dx=dy=0.125 and a periodic left-right topology with no duplicate endpoint cells.
Both runs start from eta_sol at the exact cell centres and t=0 and execute exactly two dt=0.01 steps to t=0.02.
The official-literal face values are exactly 1 and 0; the exact-trace companion uses eta_sol face traces at every new time and is labelled non-PFHub.
The two boundary definitions and endpoint digests are distinct; neither result is relabelled as literal-self evidence.
Every state, source, pre-solve residual, post-solve residual and metric is finite; post-solve algebraic L2 residual is at most 1e-10 and solver actual iterations do not exceed 2000.
The discrete-L2 oracle for a constant two-unit cell field equals sqrt(2) within 2e-15 absolute tolerance.
Conservative restriction of a synthetic affine fine-cell field equals its coarse-cell-centre values within 2e-15 maximum absolute tolerance.
The analytic boundary-tail mismatch is positive, below the registered conservative bound and explicitly records initialBoundaryCompatibility=false.
claimAndFailure: A passing receipt keeps reproduced, rankingEligible, convergenceVerified, strictOfficialMms, physicalModelValidated, realMaterialMapped, causalEffectIdentified, industrialRecommendationAuthorized, automaticControlAuthorized and evidenceScoreIncreaseAuthorized false.
Any identity, platform, closure, warning, topology, boundary, endpoint-time, residual, finite-value or track-separation failure emits a machine-readable abstention and no pass receipt.
No exploratory calibration output, historical FiPy output or R17 endpoint is read or included.
resolvedSpecAndCleanRoomOracle: Every acceptance test stated in this v4 file is mandatory; every auditHistory file is non-normative and supplies identity and correction history only.
The five prefreeze P1 corrections must be represented literally in the receipt and focused mutation tests.
The frozen LinearPCGSolver arguments, single-solve-per-step count and clean-room A, b and endpoint comparisons must pass for official-literal and exact-trace-companion.

The clean-room oracle module/function source must have no import, dynamic import, file read or subprocess path to FiPy or R17 implementations; a static test and runtime import sentinel must enforce this.
Changing reaction time level, source time level, exact-trace time, periodic wrap, a Dirichlet factor of two or a track provenance boolean must fail a focused test or the semantic receipt gate.
The v1 rounded-down bound, dimensional claims, historical date and pfhubOfficial track field are forbidden in the effective receipt.

cleanRoomOracle.languageAndDependencies: Python standard library plus NumPy dense linear algebra; the oracle function must not import FiPy or any R17 module and must not inspect FiPy matrices while constructing its result.
cleanRoomOracle.layout: index=j*Nx+i, x varies fastest; x neighbors wrap modulo Nx; no duplicate periodic endpoint
cleanRoomOracle.immutableOldState: At each step, copy eta^n before evaluating reaction and source; do not read eta^(n+1) until b is complete.
cleanRoomOracle.timeSemantics: reaction uses eta^n, source uses cell centres at t_n, exact-trace face values use t_(n+1), literal faces remain 1 and 0
comparison: Normalize FiPy A and b by dt/cellVolume before comparison to the clean-room matrix and vector.
At every step and for both executed tracks, maximum absolute A-entry and b-entry differences must be at most 2e-13.
Solve the clean-room dense system exactly once with numpy.linalg.solve and require endpoint maximum absolute difference from FiPy at most 2e-12.
A mismatch is a machine abstention; no retry, matrix repair, adaptive tolerance or alternative step is allowed.
